items.rationale: Section 2.4.3(a) covers the failed indoor supply pipe, and §7.1.7(c) covers matching sealing and insulation. One materials flat rate is estimated at €180 gross using the comparable bathroom repair in Case 39.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary trade labour at customary rates. The invoice bills one flat-rate unit, priced at the supplied €76 benchmark without imputing additional hours.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge per contractor per invoice, regardless of the number of visits. This is the only travel charge on the repair invoice: 1 × €81 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover necessary drying and one equipment deployment charge per drying operation. One flat rate at the supplied benchmark is €439 gross.

items.description: Close and repaint the wall opening
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(a) covers making good the necessary access opening, and the work is confined to the disturbed patch as required by §7.1.5. One unit at the supplied benchmark is €453 gross.
